arithmetic_function_catalog.note: 38 named base functions plus two blind variants. Refer to exact Python definitions for modular reduction, integer floor/max/absolute-value semantics and parity wrapping. Implementation does not imply every label has a completed neural run.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Raw modular division
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: q = a * inverse(b) mod p, b != 0
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Successful delayed generalization is recorded. Other recipes have early learning, failure or later relapse; representation/optimizer/seed matter.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Powered modular division
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Many successful and failed cases retained; K=2 has strong larger-model results. This K is a power, not a derivative order.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Differenced division equations
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: [a, b-a] -> q-b, with codec offsets, q=a/b mod 97
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: No successful short-context differenced-division grokking located; the saved k=1 pilot fit train but tested at about 0.92% after 1000 epochs.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Division across time-series rows
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: The high-accuracy context-48 run is explained by copying the period; short-context division remains unresolved in the recorded studies.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Fibonacci across time-series rows
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Successful three-seed generalization/grokking anchors are recorded; training regressions also use a 90% decoded-accuracy target.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Associative division and register machine
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: Load key/value registers, retrieve queried operands, compute modular division, and optionally write computed values for later operations.
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: N=2 operand copying includes the Peri-RMSNorm speedup. Distinct-query controls permit a shortcut and do not establish unrestricted binding or division.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Basis depth
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: Label each prefix by membership in alternating-block language E_k.
variants: planned L_k with no neutral tokens/NoPositions, k=1..6

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Basis associative recall
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: Answer each queried key with its latest written value.
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: The latest public GPT + ordinary AdamW passes hard recall on model seeds 0/1/2 at 2550/2600/2650 updates.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Basis parity and parity stress tests
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: Whether a bit string contains an odd number of ones.
variants: scratchpad variants in the synthetic suite

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Mixed modular polynomial and composed chains
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: a^3 + a*b mod p; chains z <- z^3 + b*z + c mod p
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: The long mixed-pair P97/P193 runs fit all training rows but remain near chance at 100000 updates; paired raw-division controls generalize.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Weather formulas as independent equations
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Measured formula learning, quantization ceilings, shortcut controls and bounded negative long runs are recorded; several confirmations remain unfinished.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Multivariate weather formula learning
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.rule: Predict weather rows with per-column metrics and same-row physical relationships.
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Fast validation improvements are recorded; the planned late extensions were deferred.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Synthetic stochastic series
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Lattice processes have three-seed fast skill crossings. Gaussian controls are implemented but recorded as not run in the execution plan.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Real forecasting
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Fast validation gains are recorded, but the documented free-running GPT forecasts lose to seasonal naive; these gains do not establish useful forecasting or delayed grokking.

additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.name: Noise tolerance on arithmetic/recurrence anchors
additional_benchmark_families_and_protoc.recorded_outcome: Div97 noise and some Fibonacci controls completed; remaining Fibonacci long fallbacks are bounded/deferred.
